newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers concessions on Black Sea beaches.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers concessions on Black Sea beaches.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet decided on Thursday to grant concession rights on its popular Black Sea beaches to private operators offering tourist services.

"The government decided to open a procedure for granting concessions over 76 beaches through the Construction Ministry," Nikola Baltov, head of the government's concessions department, told reporters after Thursday's cabinet meeting.
He said the concessions would be granted for three to five years. Tender winners would have no right to collect entrance fees but would make a profit by offering services.
Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, long popular with holidaymakers from the former Soviet Union, attracts increasing numbers of package tourists from western Europe.
